[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Run Start (Experiment Date): [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

Run End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

Overview of Automated Workflow:

  1. Manual Sample Loading (Utility - Pause)
    • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The sample loop was manually filled with the prepared sample before starting the ÄKTA method.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Chromatography Run (AKTA Pure - Run Protocol)
    • The predefined ÄKTA Pure protocol was started after manual loop filling.
    • Sample monitoring signals recorded during the run included:
      • UV signal: uv1
      • Conductivity signal: cond
    • Sample data were acquired with a sampling time of 1 s per point.
Run Parameter Summary
Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Identifier of the automated chromatography process.
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Total time of column equilibration before sample loading.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate used during the equilibration phase.
Load/Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Duration of the sample load/injection step.
Load/Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during sample loading/injection.
Elution Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total duration of the elution gradient step.
Elution Gradient Start (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer B percentage of the gradient.
Elution Gradient End (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer B percentage of the gradient.
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of post-elution wash.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during wash step.
CIP Duration (Step 1) [[CIP_DURATION]] Duration of initial cleaning-in-place (CIP) step.
CIP Duration (Step 2 Hold) [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP step.
CIP Duration (Step 3) [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP step.
CIP Duration (Step 4) [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP step.
CIP Duration (Step 5) [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP step.
